sn13.1:1.1: The root sense of _abhisamaya_ is “gathering”, as a group of brahmins for a congress (Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 3.1.1), or as breaths to a dying man (4.4.1), or as blessings like winnings to the good (Chāndogya Upaniṣad 4.1.4). In Buddhism, it acquires the technical sense of the “comprehension” of the Dhamma at least at stream-entry. The English word “gather” has a similar meaning, to come to a conclusion by intuitively putting two and two together.
sn13.1:2.6: For a stream-enterer, countless future lives of suffering have ceased, and only seven rebirths at most remain.
